svg.title: DIA-202 · Already switched on
svg.desc: An engraved plate of a switch panel bolted to a wall. Three heavy lever switches stand in a row, each lever already thrown up to the word ON, with the OFF end of its slot empty. Their nameplates read Google AI Overviews, LinkedIn AI training and Microsoft 365 Copilot. The fourth position, nameplate Meta WhatsApp assistant, has no lever at all: a blank cover, drawn in rust, is screwed down where the switch would be. Notes under each give the date and the default: switched on for all US users on 14 May 2024 with no opt-out, member posts used for training in 2024 with the opt-out switch already set to on, bundled into Microsoft 365 in January 2025 with the price raised, and in 2024 no off switch.
svg.text: PART II · BENEATH THE SEARCH RESULT
DIA-202 · Four products, four defaults: each arrived switched on, and one came with no switch.
